summary: Owner login flow tested end-to-end in the browser at the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 5 requested scenarios PASS. Login with admin@workshop.com / workshop123 authenticates, redirects to /admin, dashboard renders with all 3 tabs. Wrong password shows inline error 'Invalid email or password'. Session persists across reload / direct /admin navigation (httpOnly cookie). Logout returns to /login and /admin correctly redirects unauthenticated users back to /login.
action_items: No fix required. Reassure the user: login works. If they still cannot sign in, most likely cause is browser-side (autofill inserted an extra space in email/password, caps-lock, using an old cached password from password manager, or third-party cookie blocking preventing the httpOnly SameSite=None cookie from being stored in some strict browser/incognito setups). Ask them to type the credentials manually and check browser console/network for the /api/auth/login response.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth cookie is set with samesite=none, secure=true — correct for cross-site preview URL over HTTPS; works fine here.
Frontend axios uses withCredentials and relative /api fallback — verified session persists after full-page reload.
test_credentials: admin@workshop.com / workshop123 (from review_request; /app/memory/test_credentials.md not consulted since creds were provided and confirmed working).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow is fully functional. Verified: (1) wrong pw -> inline error 'Invalid email or password' via login-error, (2) correct pw -> redirect to /admin, logout-btn + tab-bookings/tab-slots/tab-settings all visible, (3) direct navigation to /admin after login keeps session (cookie persists), (4) tabs clickable with no console errors, (5) logout redirects to /login and /admin re-redirects to /login when unauthenticated. Console showed only expected 401s (from wrong-password test and from /api/auth/me probe after logout).
rca of the issue: No bug reproduced. User report of 'login not working' could not be confirmed. Most probable root causes on user side: (a) password manager autofilling stale/incorrect password with trailing space, (b) third-party/strict cookie blocking preventing SameSite=None cookie storage (e.g., Safari ITP, Brave shields, incognito with strict tracking prevention) — mitigation: ask user to test in a normal Chrome window and type credentials manually; if still failing, capture DevTools Network tab for POST /api/auth/login to see actual status/response.
